blocks.html: Cookie options used when setting cookies in the HTTP layer.

types.name: secure
types.description: Whether the cookie should only be sent over HTTPS connections.

types.name: sameSite
types.description: The `SameSite` attribute of the cookie, controlling cross-site request behavior.

types.name: maxAge
types.description: The maximum age of the cookie in milliseconds.

types.name: httpOnly
types.description: Whether the cookie is accessible only via HTTP(S) and not JavaScript.

types.name: priority
types.description: The priority of the cookie as defined in RFC 8030.

types.name: domain
types.description: The domain for which the cookie is valid.

types.name: path
types.description: The URL path for which the cookie is valid.

types.name: signed
types.description: Whether the cookie should be signed.
